components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Existing shared button variant; preview labels are illustrative.
components.css: .ds-button { font-family: var(--font-body, Roboto, sans-serif); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--button-radius, 0px); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; min-height: 44px; padding: .55rem .95rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; background: var(--action, #315f85); color: var(--brand-ink, #ffffff); border-color: transparent; } .ds-button:hover { background: var(--action-hover, #264a68); } .ds-button:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .45; transform: none; } .ds-control:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--action, #315f85); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button { transition: none; } }

components.css: .ds-button { font-family: var(--font-body, Roboto, sans-serif); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--button-radius, 0px); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; min-height: 44px; padding: .55rem .95rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; background: #ffffff; color: var(--ink, #2e2e2e); border-color: var(--line, #d8dfe5); } .ds-button:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #edf3f8); border-color: var(--brand, #4682b4); } .ds-button:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .45; transform: none; } .ds-control:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--action, #315f85); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button { transition: none; } }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Label above a full-width field with persistent keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:.35rem; font-family: var(--font-body, Roboto, sans-serif); } .ds-label { font-size:.82rem; color:var(--muted, #58636e); font-weight:600; } .ds-input { width:100%; border:1px solid var(--line-strong, #81909d); border-radius:var(--radius-control, 10px); font-family: var(--font-body, Roboto, sans-serif); font-size:16px; min-height:44px; transition:border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; line-height:1.35; color:var(--ink, #2e2e2e); background:#fff; padding:.62rem .7rem; caret-color:var(--action, #315f85); } .ds-input::placeholder { color:var(--muted, #58636e); opacity:1; } .ds-control:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--action, #315f85); outline-offset: 1px; border-color:var(--action, #315f85); } .ds-input:hover { border-color:var(--action, #315f85); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-input { transition:none; } }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Square utility navigation link; the current route uses the shared active treatment.
components.css: .ds-link { font-family: var(--font-body, Roboto, sans-serif); border:1px solid var(--brand, #4682b4); border-radius:var(--button-radius, 0px); display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:44px; padding:.45rem .75rem; font-size:.875rem; font-weight:700; color:var(--action, #315f85); background:var(--surface-hover, #edf3f8); white-space:nowrap; text-decoration:none; } .ds-link:hover { background:var(--surface-hover, #edf3f8); border-color:var(--brand, #4682b4); } .ds-control:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--action, #315f85); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Neutral Status Badge
components.description: Non-interactive neutral status badge; readable text carries the meaning.
components.css: .ds-badge { font-family:var(--font-body, Roboto, sans-serif); display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.4rem; border-radius:999px; padding:.22rem .6rem; font-size:.76rem; font-weight:700; line-height:1.3; white-space:nowrap; border:1px solid #c8d2dc; background:#edf2f6; color:#334155; } .ds-badge::before { content:""; width:.5rem; height:.5rem; border-radius:50%; background:currentColor; flex-shrink:0; }

components.name: Ticket Card
components.description: Shared linked ticket container; request-card structure and desktop table behavior are documented in DESIGN.md.
components.css: .ds-card { font-family: var(--font-body, Roboto, sans-serif); border:1px solid var(--line, #d8dfe5); border-radius:var(--radius-panel, 12px); background:#fff; padding:.85rem .95rem; display:grid; gap:.45rem; color:var(--ink, #2e2e2e); text-decoration:none; transition:border-color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-card:hover { background:var(--surface-hover, #edf3f8); border-color:var(--brand, #4682b4); } .ds-title { font-family:var(--font-display, Roboto, sans-serif); font-weight:700; } .ds-muted { color:var(--muted, #58636e); } .ds-control:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--action, #315f85); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-card { transition:none; } }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Shared white panel with quiet depth; responsive edge-to-edge exceptions are documented in DESIGN.md.
components.css: .ds-panel { font-family:var(--font-body, Roboto, sans-serif); color:var(--ink, #2e2e2e); background:var(--bg-elevated, #ffffff); border:1px solid var(--line, #d8dfe5); border-radius:var(--radius-panel, 12px); box-shadow:var(--shadow-panel, 0 1px 2px rgb(46 46 46 / 5%)); padding:1.25rem; min-width:0; display:grid; gap:1rem; } .ds-panel-title { margin:0; font-family:var(--font-display, Roboto, sans-serif); font-size:1.25rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-.015em; line-height:1.25; text-wrap:balance; } .ds-panel-muted { color:var(--muted, #58636e); margin:0; } @media (min-width:760px) { .ds-panel { padding:1.5rem; } } @media (max-width:600px) { .ds-panel { padding:1rem; } }

components.name: Project Tab
components.description: Icon-led project tab with a current-page underline; phone tab-bar composition is documented in DESIGN.md.
components.html: Operations
components.css: .ds-project-tabs { display:flex; gap:.25rem; overflow-x:auto; scrollbar-width:none; } .ds-project-tab { font-family:var(--font-body, Roboto, sans-serif); display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.45rem; min-height:46px; padding:.5rem .9rem; border-bottom:3px solid transparent; border-radius:0; color:var(--muted, #58636e); font-size:.925rem; font-weight:600; white-space:nowrap; text-decoration:none; } .ds-project-tab:hover { color:var(--action, #315f85); background:var(--surface-hover, #edf3f8); } .ds-project-tab[aria-current="page"] { color:var(--action, #315f85); border-bottom-color:var(--action, #315f85); font-weight:700; } .ds-project-tab:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--action, #315f85); outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview:
The pinned visual authority is the Axiom Civil Services Brand Guide, version 1.0, September 2026, supplied at `D:/Programming/_references/Axiom Brand/Axiom_Civil_Services_2026_Brand_Guide.pdf`. Future UI work must follow that identity. This document records the implemented shared foundation; it does not create a replacement identity or introduce product claims.

White dominates the interface, with slate text, steel blue structure, restrained orange attention, and Roboto throughout. Existing task flows retain their content and behavior. This is a scan of `src/app/globals.css`, `src/components/ui/product-brand.tsx`, and the authentication and projects layouts, not a claim that every screen has been visually audited.
keyCharacteristics: Steel blue structure and darker blue actions.
Supplied Axiom artwork and self-hosted Roboto.
Compact task controls with visible keyboard focus.

rules.name: The Brand Authority Rule
rules.body: Preserve the pinned Axiom palette and artwork when extending the interface.

dos: Do follow the Axiom Civil Services Brand Guide v1.0, September 2026, for future UI work.
Do keep white dominant, slate readable, steel blue structural, and orange limited to attention.
Do preserve the supplied logo, its proportions, and at least A cap-height clear space.
Do retain self-hosted Roboto and its OFL license.
Do retain visible keyboard focus, reduced-motion support, and readable state labels.
donts: Don't substitute a new brand palette, font pairing, or invented logo.
Don't use Steel Blue in place of Action Blue for small white button labels.
Don't treat generated tonal previews as approved application colors.
Don't introduce marketing claims or change task flows through visual refinement.
